verdict.rationale: Isaac Lab is explicitly described as 'open-source' (nvidia-isaac-docs-17/6), GR00T N1 was released under an Apache-2.0 license per community coverage (nvidia-isaac-comm-2), and Isaac Sim's source is hosted publicly on GitHub with feature docs (nvidia-isaac-gh-1/2/3). However, the pack lacks an explicit license file citation for Isaac Sim or Isaac ROS, and Isaac ROS's status (open vs. proprietary NITROS components) is unclear. Missing for 10: explicit license text/citation for Isaac Sim and Isaac ROS repos, clarity on which sub-components are closed vs open.
